## Services

- [Car aircond](https://apcar.com.my/car-aircond-kuantan/): Car aircond repair in Kuantan starts with finding why it is not cold: a leak, the compressor, the condenser or the cooling coil. Then we fix it and measure the vent.
- [ADAS calibration](https://apcar.com.my/adas-calibration-kuantan/): ADAS calibration in Kuantan, done in our own bay: we read the fault, aim the radar or camera with Autel / MaxiSys equipment, then road test ACC and lane keep.
- [Hybrid & EV](https://apcar.com.my/hybrid-ev-repair-kuantan/): Hybrid and EV car repair in Kuantan: we diagnose IMA and hybrid-system warnings, hybrid batteries and the electric A/C compressors that hybrids and EVs use.
- [ECU & diagnosis](https://apcar.com.my/ecu-repair-diagnosis-kuantan/): ECU repair and car diagnosis in Kuantan: a full Autel scan finds which module is at fault, then we repair, replace or code it and explain what we found.
- [Battery](https://apcar.com.my/car-battery-kuantan/): Car battery work in Kuantan, both kinds: we test and replace 12V batteries, and we diagnose and replace hybrid battery packs and their sensor boards.
- [Servicing](https://apcar.com.my/car-servicing-kuantan/): Car servicing in Kuantan for local and continental cars: oil service, cabin filter, brakes and the small repairs found along the way.

## Cars with real jobs

- [BMW](https://apcar.com.my/brands/bmw/): BMW aircond and repair in Kuantan at an independent workshop: cooling coils, electric A/C compressors on hybrids, warning-light diagnosis and EV work.
- [Mercedes-Benz](https://apcar.com.my/brands/mercedes-benz/): Mercedes-Benz aircond and repair in Kuantan at an independent workshop: A/C parts and coding, ECM and ECU work, and battery testing.
- [Porsche](https://apcar.com.my/brands/porsche/): Porsche aircond and EV repair in Kuantan at an independent workshop: our own videos show a Taycan scanned at the shop and a Panamera aircond job.
- [Honda](https://apcar.com.my/brands/honda/): Honda ADAS, hybrid and aircond repair in Kuantan: many of our ADAS calibrations and hybrid jobs are Hondas, at an independent workshop.
- [Toyota](https://apcar.com.my/brands/toyota/): Toyota aircond, hybrid and ADAS repair in Kuantan at an independent workshop, from Alphard pre-crash calibration to Camry Hybrid cooling coils and regular servicing.
